projects.title: General Dumps
projects.desc: Failed experiments, desk hazards, and general dumb shit.

logs.title: Letting the Magic Smoke Out
logs.content: Note to self: 12V and 5V rails are not interchangeable just because the jumper wires are both red. Blew the voltage regulator on the new synth board entirely off the PCB. It made a very satisfying 'pop' before smelling like burnt plastic.

logs.title: Why do we still use Phillips screws?
logs.content: I just stripped three screws trying to open this vintage 90s chassis. Torx exists. Hex exists. Why did humanity settle on a screw head specifically designed to cam out and ruin your day?

logs.title: Desk is officially a hazard
logs.content: Current desk inventory: 4 half-finished microcontrollers, a soldering iron I forgot to turn off for an hour, 12 empty coffee cups, and a pile of resistors I knocked off the strip.
